description.en: Install ALSCL, prepare the survey tables, and fit the worked YTF example.
description.zh: 安装 ALSCL、准备调查输入表，并完成 YTF 示例拟合。

description.en: Understand the model assumptions and time scales, then choose initial values, bounds and estimated parameters.
description.zh: 理解模型假设与时间尺度，设置初值、边界和待估参数。

description.en: Generate data with known truth and explore annual and quarterly assessment workflows.
description.zh: 生成具有已知真值的模拟数据，了解年度与季度评估流程。

description.en: Check fits and residuals, compare model results, and assess retrospective patterns.
description.zh: 检查拟合与残差、比较模型结果，并评估回溯分析中的变化。

description.en: Visualize survey data, population quantities, growth, mortality and residuals; customize and export figures.
description.zh: 绘制调查数据、种群指标、生长、死亡率与残差图，调整样式并导出图片。

description.en: Save analysis settings, record the computing environment, and resolve common data and compilation issues.
description.zh: 保存分析设置、记录计算环境，并排查常见数据与编译问题。
